name: DERMIS-1
group: Roflumilast cream 0.3% vs vehicle in chronic plaque psoriasis; primary IGA success at week 8 (Lebwohl JAMA 2022)
robSource: Lebwohl 2022 JAMA: randomised, double-blind, vehicle-controlled phase 3
snippet: DERMIS-1 NCT04211363: Lebwohl MG et al. JAMA 2022;328:1073-1084. Chronic plaque psoriasis, roflumilast cream 0.3% (n=255) vs vehicle (n=132). Primary IGA success at week 8: 108/255 (42.4%) vs 8/132 (6.1%), p<0.001. Per-arm counts and denominators AACT-verified.

evidence.label: Primary: IGA success (wk 8)
evidence.text: IGA success at week 8: roflumilast 108/255 (42.4%) vs vehicle 8/132 (6.1%), p<0.001.
